<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Caller.

'''Card text:''' May deploy on an Imperial or Jawa. During your control phase, you may steal one droid at the same location that is controlled by a [[Restraining Bolt]]. If you steal the droid, the restraining bolt returns to its owner's hand.

'''Lore:''' A handheld device for commanding a restraining bolt. A caller and restraining bolt correspond one-to-one. Widely used throughout the galaxy, it is also called an “owner.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text says the droid must be at the same location; the English says the same site. Japanese lore states a one-to-one correspondence between caller and bolt, while the English says each caller can be keyed to a specific bolt.
